Description: Rural Prosperous (A1) tier - landowners, estate directors, affluent retirees. Rural has no S/A2/B1/C2/E1/E2/F2/UNI zone-types per Community_matrix, so only A1/C1/D1/D2/F1 are populated.
Rural New-Build Family (C1) tier - commuter-belt dual-income households, car-dependent per OAC rural pen portrait.
Rural Mixed (D1) tier - estate workers and self-employed rural trades, OAC Rural & Outlying Areas.
Rural Agricultural (D2) tier - farm and land-management labour, owner-occupied but rural hidden poverty per IMD.
Rural Deprived (F1) tier - post-industrial rural hardship (Welsh valleys / Durham pit village style), employment + health deprivation.
Suburb Prosperous (A1) tier - OAC Retired Professionals, high asset ownership. Suburb has no S/A2/D1/D2/E1/F2/TECH/GAME zone-types per Community_matrix.
Suburb Academic (B1) tier - university-adjacent professional suburb, elevated civic/political engagement.
Suburb Professional/Middle Class (C1+C2) tier - established owner-occupier suburban belt, dual income new-build estates.
Suburb Grassroots (E2) tier - suburban trade and self-employment zone, skilled trade NS-SEC L8-L11 elevated.
Suburb Deprived (F1) tier - pockets of suburban deprivation, smallest tier in the Region per Community_matrix.
Town Professional (C1) tier - market-town professional base, teachers/nurses/council anchored, ASG AB above national average.
Town Middle Class (C2) tier - coastal/market-town retirees and working-age service economy support.
Town Mixed New Town (B2) tier - planned mixed-income new town, balanced NS-SEC spread by design.
Town Working-Class (D2) tier - manufacturing/trade original base of the market town.
Town Deprived (F1) tier - coastal-town style deprivation, IMD 2025 coastal towns among most deprived LSOAs.
